data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_2: Explicit dd1.json data contract — task-2 produces, task-3 consumes. JSON schema fragment: {phase: string, captured_at: ISO8601, label_only_orphan_count: integer, bridge_fsck_command: string, git_sha: string, api_path_used: boolean}. task-3 reads ONLY {label_only_orphan_count} (as 'before_count' in dd2.json). If task-2 output format changes (field renamed/removed), task-3 RED test catches it via fixture-mismatch. Document contract verbatim in both task-2 and task-3 descriptions; deviation is a breaking change requiring coordinated revision.
